title: Muddy Shoes
description: After her first day of kindergarten, kid-3 tells Grandma she cannot go back because her brand-new white sneakers got muddy. Grandma listens as kid-3 explains the very serious problem.
alt: In a cozy autumn entryway, kid-3 stands on the left wearing a backpack and muddy white sneakers while Grandma crouches on the right wearing an apron labeled 'Grandma.' Kid-3 says, 'Grandma, I can’t go back to kindergarten.' Grandma asks, 'Why?' Kid-3 replies, 'Because my new shoes got muddy.'
